scenarios.busy: Every continuous parameter (18) moves every block

paces.spin: the audio thread spins until each block is due, so its core stays awake and a block's time is the code's alone
paces.idle: the audio thread sleeps until each block is due, so its core may drop into a sleep state and wake with cold caches, as in a light session; how deep it sleeps is the machine's, not the comparison's, and moves these times by up to three times at small blocks
